registered_stage: before development-v5 or independent model calls
reason: Requested models share task families and paired effects may be correlated across models.
historical_results: No changes or retrospective regrading; runs without the new collector marker retain their original analysis.
existing_acceptance: All original quality, fresh-receipt, coverage, stratified-model interval and per-model point gates remain necessary.

additional_acceptance.method: paired joint task-family block bootstrap preserving all requested models and all instances within each selected family
additional_acceptance.required_family_coverage: Each sampled family must cover every requested model.
additional_acceptance.enforcement: New collector runs require both additional intervals; callers cannot disable the requirement.

limits: Four known task families and two requested same-provider models; no new task-family, multiple-vendor or Stable qualification claim.
